entries.name: UNDO LAST SESSION CHANGE
entries.purpose: Restore the last clear or bulk-archive recovery checkpoint.
entries.promise: The button appears only when a durable checkpoint exists; clicking restores exact history/archive state, returns to the recovered active session when valid, clears the checkpoint, and persists restoration across restart.
entries.notes: Live @ HEAD: #ws-undo (UNDO LAST SESSION CHANGE) present+wired, correctly HIDDEN when no undoable change exists (truthful). AUDITED: W.undoLast restore covered by session-power-tools.test.js; live undo not driven (no change to undo in seed).
